entry.title: JPMorgan's Guven Toktamis on Private Equity DPI & Outlook
entry.summary: Pressure to show strong distributed paid-in capital (DPI) is top of mind in the private equity space, says Isik Guven Toktamis, JPMorgan EMEA Head of Private Equity Investment Banking. "2026 has been actually been a good year for sponsored M&A. Overall, M&A volume is up by 40%, and we continue to have a very strong pipeline, of exits," she added. Guven Toktamis spoke with Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie

entry.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
entry.summary: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

entry.title: Billions Pour Into OpenAI, DeepSeek Ahead of IPOs
entry.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down OpenAI's talks with multiple investors to raise at least $30 billion at a valuation of about $1.4 trillion. Plus, DeepSeek is also close to securing at least $12 billion in funding ahead of its own IPO next year, and JPMorganChase CEO Jamie Dimon weighs in on data centers and AI risks from London's Tech Stars event. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: CFTC, SEC Put 'Some Wind' Into Early VC Stage: Ross
entry.summary: Alex Ross, managing partner of Illuminate Financial, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the current climate for crypto venture capital. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: CATL and Tencent back Deepseek's ballooning funding round as the AI startup eyes a 2027 IPO
entry.summary: Deepseek is close to raising at least $12 billion in a new funding round, Bloomberg reports. The article CATL and Tencent back Deepseek's ballooning funding round as the AI startup eyes a 2027 IPO appeared first on The Decoder.

entry.title: Nordic Data Center Group ASP Is Said to Weigh Oslo IPO
entry.summary: AI infrastructure developer ASP Data Center AS is considering an initial public offering in Oslo that could raise the equivalent of about $100 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: AI to See Massive Adoption 'Unseen' in Previous Tech Cycles, Says Neostellar Principal
entry.summary: American AI companies’ performance lead over China narrowed sharply in past months to a record low after labs such as DeepSeek gained ground, threatening US tech supremacy, according to Bloomberg Intelligence. Willy Lee, Principal at Neostellar, offers his view from the VC world when it comes to AI investments and the IPO market. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: JPMorgan's Dimon Weighs In on AI Boom, Bond Selloff and UK Banks
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase Chairman and CEO Jamie Dimon discusses the issues behind financing the AI boom, the global bond selloff and the state of UK banks. He speaks with Tom Mackenzie at JPMorgan's Tech Stars Conference in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Mythos Drove Up Cyber Risk 10-Fold, Says JPMorgan's Dimon
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Chief Executive Officer Jamie Dimon says artificial intelligence has exposed new vulnerabilities for banks. He says the risks of cyber attacks have gone up 10-fold since the release of Anthropic's Mythos ai model. He speaks exclusively to Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie at the JPMorgan Tech Stars Conference in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Flai’s AI dealership software is booking 50,000 appointments per month
entry.summary: Flai's revenue has grown 20x in a year, and the company just closed a $27 million Series A funding round.

entry.title: Wayve CEO Kendall on the Future of Driving
entry.summary: Wayve CEO Alex Kendall discusses the future of driving, the market for autonomous vehicles in the US and China, as well as the possibility of a future IPO. He spoke with Bloomberg TV's Tom Mackenzie on the sidelines of the JPMorgan Tech Stars conference in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: JPMorgan Tops Global AI Banking Index for Fifth Straight Year
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. held its spot as the world’s most advanced bank in artificial intelligence for a fifth straight year, widening its lead over rivals in an annual ranking that shows AI deployment across the industry is accelerating at a record pace.

entry.title: China AI Video Startup Kling Picks Banks for $1 Billion-Plus IPO
entry.summary: Kuaishou Technology’s Kling AI has picked banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: Anthropic is quietly becoming America's biggest corporate donor ahead of its mega IPO
entry.summary: Anthropic employees donated $540 million in 2025 alone, nearly five times as much as the next-largest Fortune 500 donors, thanks to a company program that tops up every stock donation with extra shares and triples contributions from early employees. entry.title: Singapore’s DayOne Files for US IPO Joining AI Data Center Rush
entry.summary: DayOne Data Centers Ltd. filed for a US initial public offering, setting the Singapore-headquartered firm up to capture investors’ resilient demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Rothschild Capital Management and an Anthropic investor, says the AI company can continue creating value after going public as it compounds growth over the long term. entry.title: Schneider Expands in AI With $23 Billion Acquisition
entry.summary: Bloomberg's Liana Baker discusses Schneider Electric’s roughly $23 billion cross-border acquisition of software firm PTC, describing it as the French company’s largest deal and a strategic push into industrial software. She speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Skydance's Big Bet: Streaming, Debt, and AI
entry.summary: Michael J. Wolf, co-founder and CEO of Activate joined Bloomberg Open Interest to break down the $110B Skydance–Paramount merger, how cable still "banks" streaming, and why AI is reshaping costs, jobs, and growth across corporate America, before the real gains ever hit the bottom line. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Better Uptime Monitoring for Small SaaS API and Cron Healthchecks

Use an external request check for reachability, and emit a completion heartbeat only after an import has produced and committed an acceptable result.
